mainText: Hello, Verona! At 9 PM, here is today's balanced dish: skies are clear at Reddan Soccer Park under a New Moon. Temperatures will reach an overnight low of 36 degrees with no rain in the forecast.

The city is conducting pavement repairs on November 10 and 11. Contractors will be milling near Nine Mound Road and Morningside Boulevard on the 10th, followed by paving all locations on the 11th. Please note the no-parking zones from 7 AM to 7 PM on those days.

We have a busy week ahead! Live music is playing today at Bailey's Run Vineyard. Tomorrow, you can catch a yoga session at Insight Wellness. Later this week, join us for trivia at Hop Haus, Lake Lou-ee, or Paddy Mac's, and enjoy some pizza and pitchers at Lake Lou-ee on November 11.
In our weekly report, on October 25, officers were dispatched to Plympton Street and Rita Avenue where they located a 40-year-old man who was arrested for O W I, first offence.
Today's flavor of the day is the delicious Salted Double Caramel Pecan. The store is currently open and serving until 11 PM, so there is still plenty of time to stop by for a treat.
